notes.title: v1.0.7 Patch - QOL Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Patch 1.0.7 is live NOW on Steam and it includes some new QOL updates, adjustments, bug fixes, and accessibility options. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/ca5befcbf1c8e304f39b3c8e7d5ba10fadca085a.gif[/img]

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] By raising each towns' Maintenance levels, you can purchase new Village Storage upgrades in the shops, allowing you to stack more resources
[*] You can also purchasing upgrades for Concord's resource inventory after raising town Maintenance levels, allowing resource stacking in their backpack
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/fd26f176ad872d9499f7465ff737fe5f34050204.gif[/img]

[b]Here's what else is new in v1.0.7:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 4 new cosmetic hats - One new hat per village, and you will automatically get Spring Hamlet's new hat!
[*] Backpack UI changes to match the cosmetic you have equipped
[*] Added the ability to use Dew Jars from the Hotbar
[*] Adjusted boss balance (including a nerf for Bookworm)
[*] Adjusted tool hitboxes - Pick, Sickle, Parasol all have new adjustment behaviors and do not interrupt movement as harshly
[*] Adjusted some Memory wording and functionality for clarity
[*] Fixed issue where Rose's favor was not completing properly
[*] Fixed issue where "Life Moves Slowly" memory was not functioning properly
[*] Fixed an infinite leaflets exploit
[*] Minor UI adjustments
[*] Miscellaneous script adjustments
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/aeaaba164849317f26380c93e98788f3b8fcb8b8.gif[/img]

[b]More Accessibility Options![/b]
[list]
[*] Added accessibility option to change dialogue text effect in Options menu
[*] Added accessibility option to remove timed elements of Waterlog Dungeon puzzles in Options menu
[*] Added accessibility option to influence VFX for weather elements
[*] Added accessibility option to influence lighting for time of day
[/list]
Many of these updates were requested throughout [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1062140/discussions/]Steam Community[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/rosecitygames]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/gardenstorygame]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/GardenStory/]Reddit[/url]. We read your comments every single day - so thank you for helping us improve the game!
That's all for now, but keep an eye out for more updates and news coming soon. 

Happy exploring!

[i](Switch Users - This patch will be available for Switch soon. As always, thank you so much for your patience!) [/i]

notes.title: Shiny New Textboxes and a Dungeon Sneak Peek?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/fe02a1f4322ff54eaa369f262f59774a4b3041e1.gif[/img]

October is almost done, and we've got lots of updates we've been working through to make YOUR first visit to the Grove a good one! Time to give you a glimpse at a few of these updates.  

--------------------------------------

[h2]Text Box Touch-ups[/h2]

Picogram has been sprucing up text boxes to look a little more interesting… more like stationary/sticky notes! We love how they add even more personality to the the already very colorful characters of Spring Hamlet (and beyond). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/4c22536a7e6ecb052c2ae144e51155bbd7f36fe0.gif[/img]

--------------------------------------
[h2]Snow’s Shop is Open for Business![/h2]

In the demo, many of you got to meet Kabocha, the shop-keeper in Autumn Town! Spring Hamlet also has a shop of it's own with loads of building supplies, tools, and even some fun bits and bobbles with more *unique* properties. Snow is the fruit-in-charge here, and they're looking forward to having you stop by for a visit! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/ccd148bf5f384a192baf07035a806e70a41c392b.gif[/img]

--------------------------------------
[h2]Sneak Peek: Dungeon Content[/h2]

From the depths of the Grove comes this *artist recreation* of part of a Rot dungeon in the works. Even in sketch form, those frowny faces are intimidating! Rana better watch out too, cause it looks like more puzzles will be a part of future adventures. 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/aebadd7d30ae89617a144f56c0121ceab6807051.png[/img]

--------------------------------------
[h2]Keep in touch! [/h2]

Until next time! Are there any topics about life in the Grove or Garden Story that you’re interested in finding out about? Let us know in the comments below! And be sure to follow us on [url=twitter.com/gardenstorygame]Twitter [/url]for more updates!

Best,

🍂 Jenny and the Garden Story Team

notes.title: Garden Story: July Recap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/4f4a6148a8a23873d35b16d7f8b6359ed5a94708.gif[/img]

July is already done (whaaaa?), which means it’s time for a [b]Garden Story[/b] update! A lot of time is being spent on larger systems, like how you’ll be working with other members of the Grove, as well as different objects and tasks for helping make your world a better place. 

We’ll share more details when we are able, but until then, here are some additional smaller updates that will hopefully whet your appetite! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Glomp glomp![/h2]

What’s this? A new, dangerous rot has been spotted! Bigger than the average Rot, these Glomps are known to come out at night, and get a bit agitated if you get close, so be careful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/c6072aa0a411dadeeb8e841b3528f476ebbcdaf6.gif[/img]

[h2]Stay Hydrated[/h2]

While the original jar was a grape idea (huhuu~), this new health bar will hopefully add more clarity to how much health Concord has while exploring, and when it’s time for a pit stop for more dew!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/3e6ed7f6660f0f62c51ce847b576d76694fb9e2b.gif[/img]

[h2]Splashy Rot[/h2]

This Acorn Rot was getting a bit too rambunctious, so we had to tone its rot splashes down a bit ~ here’s how it looks now! Be sure to use that dodge roll to provide some quick distance between Concord and their clouds. Pico’s also exploring damage counters for when you’re wacking things with your pick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/00c5fefc50f3631dca230a409aee5cad5c8b5b77.gif[/img]

[h2]Take Off your Shoes, and Enjoy![/h2]

Ever just want to walk through some soft grass? The lushness of The Grove has been intensified with the addition of more squishy foliage to walk through ~ ahhh, so refreshing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/566ca4b1cf9774cc9fb2d3a8e26bda5333bb2498.gif[/img]

[h2]Summer of Games? Summer of GRAPES![/h2]

Concord was invited to hang with a bunch of other wonderful indies during the Twitch Indie Discovery Show last week! Jenny (Communications Manager) got to share with the Twitch community the joys of fruit puns, as well as provide a reminder that the [b]Garden Story [/b]demo IS available here on Steam if you’d like to try it out (or share with friends!) 

Watch the VOD at this link (Garden Story is around the 2 hour 35 min mark): [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/693490220]https://www.twitch.tv/videos/693490220[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/8f629ea50af2b372e1c24a590fba67f08541f61a.gif[/img]

[h2]Inviting you to our Indie Arena Booth![/h2]

In just a few short weeks, the Indie Arena Booth will be open! This’ll be your chance to see more indie games, [b]Garden Story [/b]included. We’ll be running a few live events for you all to participate in, and will be posting more about that in the coming weeks! For now? The best place you’ll be able to get the insider scoop for what’s going to happen is in our [url=discord.gg/rosecitygames]Discord[/url], so be sure to join if you want to know more. 

[previewyoutube=p55uCmjxmWI;full][/previewyoutube]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We’ll keep you posted, so, again, please consider joining our [url=https://discord.gg/rosecitygames]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.gardenstorygame.com]subscribing to our newsletter[/url], or following us on [url=https://www.twitter.com/gardenstorygame]Twitter[/url]! Tomorrow, we’ll be releasing a newsletter that dives a bit more into the Library system (and sharing a taste of some Garden Story lore, so you don’t want to miss it! -- subscribe [url=https://www.gardenstorygame.com/]here[/url]).

Talk soon, 

💜 Jenny + The Garden Story team

notes.title: Garden Story May Recap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/fe02a1f4322ff54eaa369f262f59774a4b3041e1.gif[/img]

Happy Friday everyone! Time to end the week with your dose of Vitamin C...oncord! Eh? Ehh? ^_^ Okay, before I show myself out, let me first preview what Pico and the team have been hard at work with on Garden Story!

[h3]Do the Dew[/h3]
How do we know what’s in a jar? Why, by labeling it, of course! Visual indicators have been added to jars so you can identify what type of dew it stores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/1281fae1a7d44fe5f628c779738cb8e654903f4b.gif[/img]

[h3]You Are Here[/h3]
Still getting your bearings? Not only does the map showcase the name and coordinates of each area, but there’s a handy Concord pin now to show you where they are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/44d6d040e3011d44efd5ec28bd9d1a2435ec6248.gif[/img]

[h3]Updated Pick Combat[/h3]
The pick art has more detail and the animation packs a little bit more punch, so thwacking Rot feels more impactful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/8168005d747c8855e84179486028020d17f35cb6.gif[/img]

[h3]Extra Extra![/h3]
You can know it’s time to read new posts on the request board when you see this handy bobbling sign above it. In addition to these, there are general indicators above areas of interest as well, so you have an idea of where to explore if you’re stuck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/c952148572ff6d3a9c1b675cc3f59f88d1d7f28f.gif[/img]

[h3]Story Bits & Squashing Bugs[/h3]
In addition to visual tweaks and improvements, we’ve also been really dialing in the story and fixing bugs that have cropped up! It’s harder to show that type of progress, but we can say that we’re really proud of how it’s coming along, and can’t wait to reveal more of what this world is like (and what’s happening to it!) In the meantime? Here’s a gif of Concord hanging out with some fellow Spring Hamlet neighbors and enjoying a lovely rainy day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/a4e7b25c2b1618ceebfb37414dd98dad340ea01a.gif[/img]

[h3]The Wholesome Direct[/h3]
Finally, we were featured as a part of the first ever Wholesome Direct! It was an incredible experience seeing all of these indie games come together in an event that celebrated cozy vibes and kindness. Missed it? Don’t worry! The full video is available [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AwCNzOPR8Ck]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/37f771f6c977a58b284b46a1357dd7cfaad68c1f.gif[/img]

We’ll be participating in even more events in the coming months and have a few fun activities of our own up our sleeve, so be sure to pop into our [url=https://discord.gg/rosecitygames]Discord [/url]or follow us on [url=https://www.twitter.com/gardenstorygame/]Twitter [/url]to hear all about them as we share the announcements! 

Talk soon!

Jenny and the Garden Story Team

notes.title: LudoNarraCon Begins 💛
notes.content:
[h2]LudoNarraCon is here! [/h2]

We’ve been recording, prepping, coding, testing, and gathering lots of behind-the-scenes and special content to stream all weekend for the second year of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/group/33025617/view/1827838782002270091]LudoNarraCon[/url], a digital event hosted by the awesome folks of Fellow Traveler. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/7991be0ec387d7d54c1a918259897c2350e9250e.png[/img]

If you haven’t gotten to participate in LudoNarraCon before, you’re in for a treat. All weekend, there will be panels, streams, and demos to check out, all united by the fact that they celebrate games with a focus on narrative. We’re so happy that Garden Story gets to be a part of the festivities, and wanted to let you know what you can expect throughout the weekend!

[h2]Garden Story Broadcasting[/h2]

Starting Friday at 10 AM PST, we’ll also be showcasing a wide variety of content on our main Steam page! Our broadcast will loop throughout the entire weekend (the event ends on Monday, April 27th at 11:50 PM PST), so please feel free to visit our page for: [list]
[*] Pixel art with Picogram, lead developer and artist for Garden Story
[*] Tiny Jams: mini one-song shows performed by Grahm Nesbitt, composer for Garden Story
[*] Demo gameplay with Rose City Games co-founders, Will Lewis and Corey Warning, and community dev, Jenny Windom
[*] ...and more!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/bddd53aa1cac39b28a0842066d28b8050f5f9584.gif[/img]

[h2]The Autumn Town Demo Returns (Permanently!) [/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062140/Garden_Story/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/d9e32b8e9ed9138ccedb0f56a7f74f52c25f3d81.gif[/img][/url]

We’ve fixed the lift up to Autumn Town again...and this time, it’s indefinite! What was previously a limited-time demo will now be available to play even after LudoNarraCon has finished. 

Folks who have tried the demo previously offered up lots of great feedback, and we’re happy to share an updated build with lots of tweaks and fixes. This means that while it’s still a standalone experience, it will more closely resemble what you can expect in the final version of the game. Some of these updates include: [list]
[*] Making sure everything’s pixel-perfect by cleaning up animation frames, extra text in places it shouldn’t be, and setting fences in exactly the right spot!
[*] Created a toggle-able “Non-perish mode” so you can live life as a grape on the edge ~ or keep it cozy and not have to worry.
[*] Looking fancy and fresh: we’ve updated map and menu UI so you can better track your progress 
[*] Stay organized: you can now drop items you don’t need and collected items won’t disappear if your inventory is already full!
[*] Touched up and clarified the main mission and requests
[*] Finessed button remapping 
[*] Oh, and...the stump enemy has a surprise in store for you. 😎
[/list]

notes.title: Keybinding Options Now Available!
notes.content:
Oi! First off, thanks so much for checking out the [b]Autumn Town Demo[/b]! To address one of the biggest points of feedback, we're introducing keybinding options in the latest build! Now you can assign keyboard controls pretty much any way you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35149440/f92d940f948bebb18724b9b0ae1542eab148657b.png[/img]

This latest patch also addresses a handful of minor bugs, improvements to the options menu UI, and auto-detection for controllers. [b]A quick heads up[/b]: unless any new show-stopper issues arise, the demo will not be updated further. This will allow us to turn our focus back to the main game and stay on schedule. Please keep that good, good feedback coming our way so we can take it into consideration during the rest of Garden Story's development!

Remember, the Autumn Town Demo is only available until December 21st, 2019. If you haven't downloaded it yet, make sure to grab it before it's gone... and tell a friend or two if you get a chance. It super helps us out! ^_^

- Pico + Rose City Games


[i]P.S. If you enjoyed the demo, don't forget to add Garden Story to your Wishlist![/i]
